info.description: Core service for Toca ecosystem (Properties, etc)
info.title: Toca Core API

post.description: One-shot captação: cria Property + owners + capturing_brokers e emite property.captured

get.description: List partnerships for the current company context

Aggregates the shared portfolio across every ACTIVE partnership the caller participates in (and that grants shared_portfolio view). Each property is privacy-projected; the response carries the originating partnership id and source company id.

post.description: The invited (target) company accepts a pending partnership/franchise invitation, moving it to active

put.description: Update access rights for the partner

post.description: The invited (target) company rejects a pending partnership/franchise invitation, moving it to inactive

get.description: Returns the COUNTERPART company's shared properties for an active partnership the caller belongs to. Each property is privacy-projected (PII stripped, address coarsened). Requires the partnership to grant shared_portfolio view.

put.description: Update the partnership's shared-portfolio rules (owner-contact PII visibility, co-brokering, property type/region whitelists)

get.description: Get all properties with pagination and filters
Get a property by its ID

put.description: Update a property by its ID

delete.description: Delete a property by its ID

patch.description: Link or unlink an active deal/negotiation to a property

post.description: Register a capturing broker on a property from the time of captação
Register a lead as interested in a property (single source of truth)

delete.description: Remove a lead from the property's interest list

post.description: Add an owner to the property's owners list with optional percentage

commission_model.description: CommissionModel is the structured cross-company commission split.

commission_split.description:
CommissionSplit is the legacy "X/Y" string. No longer required — kept
only so old rows keep deserialising. Prefer CommissionModel.

royalty_base.description:
RoyaltyBase is the base the royalty percentage is applied to. Empty
is treated as gross_commission by EffectiveRoyaltyBase().

active_deal_id.description: ActiveDealID references the current active deal (negotiation) for this property

available_for.description: Available business types: a property can be available for sale, rent and/or exchange simultaneously

capture_exclusivity.description:
CaptureExclusivity is the brokerage exclusivity of the capture. Empty
is treated as "open". An "exclusive" capture can never be shared in
the partnership portfolio (see CanSharePartnershipPortfolio).

capturing_brokers.description: Capturing brokers: multiple brokers with roles (captador, co_captador, etc.)

interested_leads.description: InterestedLeads lists leads that expressed interest in this property

owner.description: Legacy single owner/broker (kept for backward compatibility)

owners.description: Multi-owner support: multiple owners with ownership percentage

partnership_portfolio.description: PartnershipPortfolio indicates this property is shared in the partnership portfolio

tenant_id.description: TenantID is the identifier for multi-tenancy context (AccountID)

capture_exclusivity.description:
CaptureExclusivity — "open" (default) or "exclusive". An exclusive
capture can never be shared in the partnership portfolio.

partnership_portfolio.description:
PartnershipPortfolio opts this property into the shared partnership
portfolio. Rejected by the service when CaptureExclusivity=exclusive.

deal_id.description: empty string clears the active deal

capture_exclusivity.description:
CaptureExclusivity — "open" (default) or "exclusive". An exclusive
capture can never be shared in the partnership portfolio.

partnership_portfolio.description:
PartnershipPortfolio opts this property into the shared partnership
portfolio. Rejected by the service when CaptureExclusivity=exclusive.
